team.name: Cornell
team.description: PRoSPER 将高氯酸盐处理、工程大肠杆菌与蓝细菌共培养相结合，连接火星表土处理、代谢交换和农业基质改良。ARC 生物膜反应器提供培养与接触的工艺平台。

role.zh: 表土修复与生物膜反应器

label.en: E. coli perchlorate reduction → Synechococcus metabolic exchange

team.description_en: PRoSPER combines perchlorate treatment with E. coli–cyanobacteria co-culture, linking Martian regolith treatment, metabolite exchange and growing-medium improvement. The ARC biofilm reactor provides a cultivation and contact platform.
